question: Should OpenClaw standardize `CLAW.md` as the canonical generated Claw manifest while continuing to accept JSON input, and should this slice land only after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102982?
rationale: Code review can validate the parser, serializer, and tests, but it cannot choose the permanent package representation or approve the stacked landing order while the RFC and base remain open.

options.title: Hold for RFC and base
options.body: Keep this PR draft until the RFC approves the representation and the lifecycle base is ready, then refresh proof against the final stack.

options.title: Approve CLAW.md contract
options.body: Approve `CLAW.md` as canonical output with JSON read compatibility and sequence this PR immediately after its reviewed dependencies.

options.title: Retain JSON canonical output
options.body: Decline the output-format switch and narrow the branch to optional `CLAW.md` input support or revise it to the representation selected by the RFC.

recommendation.title: Hold for RFC and base
recommendation.body: Keep this PR draft until the RFC approves the representation and the lifecycle base is ready, then refresh proof against the final stack.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is repository-wide product and package-format direction rather than a local implementation defect.
